upload.dropzone: Drop a PDF, DOCX, XLSX or CSV here, or click to choose
upload.hint: Its facts are extracted, verified and added to your memories. Spreadsheets are read sheet by sheet, row by row.
upload.discardTitle: Delete the original after extraction. Keep only the derived memories.

conversation.lead: From your conversation: <title>{{title}}</title>. The highlighted message is the source; nearby turns are shown for context.

email.originallyFrom: Originally from: <sender>{{sender}}</sender>. A reply will go to them, not the forwarder.
email.forwardUnknownSender: This arrived as a forward; the original sender couldn't be recovered, so a reply will leave the recipient for you to fill in.
email.draftCreated: Draft created. Review it on the <link>Approvals</link> page, then send it from your own mail client. Cogeto never sends mail.
email.draftExplainer: Cogeto will write a suggested reply you can edit and send yourself. It never sends mail. You approve and send from your own client.

read.title: What Cogeto read

reason.row_cap_sheet: This file is longer than the per-sheet row limit, so Cogeto read the first rows of each sheet.
reason.row_cap_file: This file is longer than the row limit for one file, so Cogeto stopped once the limit was reached.
reason.no_text: Cogeto found no readable text in this file. Nothing was extracted, and nothing was invented.
reason.unsupported_type: Cogeto does not read this kind of file yet.
reason.legacy_office_format: This is a pre-2007 Office file. Save it as .docx or .xlsx and upload it again.
reason.parse_failed: The file is of a kind Cogeto reads, but these bytes could not be parsed. It may be corrupt or password protected.
reason.parse_timeout: Reading this file took too long and was stopped.
reason.text_over_cap: This file expands to more text than Cogeto reads from one document.
reason.undecodable_text: The text in this file could not be decoded.

read.valuesUnavailable_one: {{count}} cell had no stored value, so it was left out rather than guessed.
read.valuesUnavailable_other: {{count}} cells had no stored value, so they were left out rather than guessed.
